summary: All four phases delivered their specified objectives without scope creep. The fingerprint module, baseline store, drift classifier, audit modes, governance command, and lifecycle harness are all present and match the plan's specifications. The only file outside the planned lists is render.test.ts (phase-03), which was explicitly enumerated as an optional creation in the plan section. Commit subjects match the plan exactly. All handoffs cover the required content. No missing tests or artifacts were detected.

findings.message: The frozen-value test uses an independently derived constant (raw createHash over pinned strings) rather than a literal hex string, which is a stronger tripwire than a raw inline constant — any formula change in computeFingerprint will diverge from this constant and fail loudly. This is a sound implementation choice within the plan's intent.

serializeBaseline uses [...baseline.entries].sort() rather than .toSorted() due to the ES2022 lib target in tsconfig.base.json. This triggers an oxlint unicorn/no-array-sort warning (exit 0, not error) but is the correct approach given the project-wide constraint. The plan's 'do not change tsconfig.base.json' guidance is respected.

render.test.ts was created as a new file. The plan's optional-files section explicitly states '(Create it instead as a small unit suite if rendering assertions fit better there than in spawned-process tests).' The global reconciliation table marks it as unplanned, but the plan text permits it.

The --fail-on-new missing-baseline check was moved before computeAudit in runAudit (fail-fast ordering) relative to the original phase-03 code. This is a safe internal reordering noted in the phase-04 handoff; tests verify exit code and stderr content, not internal ordering.

The byte-identity check for 'baseline unchanged' is implemented by capturing the rawContent string alongside JSON.parse, avoiding a second readFileSync. This is a sound implementation detail noted in the handoff.

attentionPoints: The pre-existing oxlint unicorn/no-array-sort warning in apps/steme/src/core/baseline/store.ts exits 0 (warning only). Resolving it requires raising tsconfig.base.json lib to ES2023, which is a project-wide decision outside this plan's scope — carry it forward to a future maintenance task if desired.
